hypotheses.reasoning: Origin: catalog-db transaction 97844 (catalog-svc-reconciler) went idle-in-transaction at 03:19:31 holding a RowExclusiveLock on products (#1637). From 03:20:22, UPDATEs on products block waiting for ShareLock on it (#1746, #1868), then hit statement_timeout in catalog-svc (#1763, #1915). search-api's GET /products/batch calls to catalog-svc time out (#1770, #1921, #2025), its catalog pool saturates (#2024), and checkout times out (#2192). This produces the web-bff 504s on /search (e.g. #1990, #2122, #2500), which are downstream symptoms. The ingest 500s (ingest-api v2.3.0 'locale' TypeError, #2041, #2089, #2212) are a separate fault on /v1/events, not the search cause.

verdict.recommendedAction: 1) Terminate the idle-in-transaction session holding transaction 97844 (catalog-svc-reconciler) on catalog-db to release the ShareLock. 2) Find why the reconciler leaves transactions open and set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout on catalog-db. 3) Bound search-api's catalog-svc pool and timeouts so a catalog-db stall fails fast. 4) Separately, roll back or hotfix ingest-api v2.3.0 (event-formatter 'locale' undefined) to stop /v1/events 500s.
